notes_for_editor: Thin record. The tnlandforms.us list (GA313) is the only source naming this site; it gives county, coordinates and an unlabelled elevation of 14, which matches the record's 4.3 m if read as feet. The name 'anguilla' is the list author's own. The record's registers entry 'BLL US 65259' matches the BLL-65259 code on that list, which the page ties to coordinates the Georgia Forestry Commission supplied; it is not a register listing. Left unchanged for a human to decide. No Georgia NHLR page for this site is in the local cache. Status and access stay unknown: no source says. The 1948 statewide report is context only, not evidence about this tower.
